state.message: Hello, the blender I ordered arrived yesterday and works fine, but it is the wrong color. I would like my money back please, I can send it back this week. Thanks so much for your help!

angry.instructions: Does the writer of state.message sound angry?

criteria.true: The message shows anger, frustration or a threat, for example blame, insults or all caps
criteria.false: The message is calm, neutral or friendly, even if it reports a problem

refund.instructions: Does state.message ask for money back?

criteria.true: Asks for a refund, a chargeback or money returned
criteria.false: Asks for something else: a replacement, store credit, a repair, or nothing
